structure.arming_amendment: ARMING AMENDMENT, 2026-10-13, BEFORE ANY FILL. This book IS NOW ARMED, and the precondition above is NOT weakened - it is enforced in CODE instead of by withholding the entry rule. Don's instruction of 2026-10-13 permits arming before the series is ready ON ONE CONDITION: that a refusal for a thin source is recorded as its own state and can never read as a quiet market. That condition is met and tested: `fleet_books._f21_source_gate` writes a named refusal row onto this book's own stream - DIP_HEALTHY_ABSENT when the stream does not exist, DIP_HEALTHY_UNFIT when it is thinner than `min_healthy_rows` or staler than `max_stale_sessions` - and returns no candidates. THAT IS STRICTLY MORE VISIBLE THAN THE PREVIOUS ARRANGEMENT: an unarmed book reports ARMED_NO_ENTRY_RULE and writes NOTHING, so the day the data became ready nobody would have been told. Armed, the book starts BY ITSELF on that day with no further human action. `min_healthy_rows` 20 and `max_stale_sessions` 5 are UNCHANGED, as is every other field; what changed is who enforces them. Measured at the time of amendment: the `dip_healthy` series carries ZERO rows, so this book cannot select anybody today.
structure.arming_precondition: DECLARED AND NOT ARMED. This book may not be armed until the `dip_healthy` series carries at least 20 recorded rows with no gap longer than 5 sessions, which is what makes 'first appearance this quarter' resolvable. Until then the entry rule refuses by name. The precondition is a property of the DATA and not of the book, and it is Don's to clear by scheduling the recorder; nothing in this declaration arms anything.
structure.crash_label: RECORDED, never an entry or exit rule: any calendar month in which this book's own equal-secured-cash equity curve falls >= 10%, OR any 32-session SPY return <= -20%. A PAYS verdict on a window containing zero labelled crash months is recorded PAYS(NO-CRASH-SEEN) and may not be quoted without that qualifier. BLEEDS needs no qualifier -- V6-OPT's declared asymmetry, inherited.
structure.delta_leg: solved on the PUT leg, V6-OPT's convention
structure.entry_source_amendment: EXECUTOR AMENDMENT, 2026-10-13, BEFORE ANY FILL. The draft entered on 'the live dip detector's HEALTHY list' read daily. MEASURED: no such series existed. `fleet_history.SERIES` held exactly three streams -- `iv60_atm`, `dip_rejects`, `alert_count` -- and `dip_rejects` is the COMPLEMENT of this book's entry population, so the names this book enters on were recorded NOWHERE and 'first appearance this quarter' could not be evaluated against anything. The book would have armed and qualified nobody, which the harness reports as RULE_ARMED_NEVER_FIRES and which is 'indistinguishable in the records from a quiet market'. A `dip_healthy` series was added and is recorded from the SAME screen the two existing callers already pay for (no new screen is run anywhere). AND THE CADENCE IS THE BINDING CONSTRAINT, NAMED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: the fleet cycle deliberately does NOT run the dip screen, and the only callers that do are `scan_worker.run_weekly` and `POST /admin/record-dip-rejects`. That is why the scout measured `dip_rejects` at 6 days against `alert_count` and `iv60_atm` at 24 -- roughly the weekly-to-daily ratio, a cadence mismatch rather than an intermittent fault. The draft's 'within 2 sessions of first appearance' is therefore NOT achievable today and has been replaced by first appearance evaluated at the series' own cadence.
structure.records_schema_note: F-2 (menu gate) and F-19 (density gate) are FIELDS and not books -- their own declarations say so ('fleet-wide convention, not a book'; 'A LABELING GATE, refuses nothing') -- so the menu depth and the density percentile are recorded on every fill here rather than carried as separate streams with 47.5- and 21.2-year horizons. None of the four collides with the 30 base RECORD_COLUMNS. The two series fields make the source's own thinness visible on the fill that used it.
structure.v6opt_argument: CONCEDED, NOT DODGED. V6-OPT's autopsy is correct: a delta target sets the strike from the name's own volatility and so equalises assignment by construction -- it measured 25.303% assignment on healthy dips against 25.727% on unhealthy, a 0.43pp gap, where V6-B had measured a real further-20%-drawdown difference of 2.797pp on those same covered rows and 10.84pp on the full panel. A RISK SIGNAL CANNOT PAY THROUGH A DELTA-TARGETED STRIKE. This book carries no risk signal and is not asked to: DECISIONS.md 2026-10-12 judges an options strategy as its own system, and its three pass clauses -- profitable net of real costs on the capital tied up in both halves, beats the same trade on random days in the same names, survives O11 sizing and the pre-committed crash stress -- are each unobstructed by a delta target. The only condition it obstructed has been withdrawn by the owner. Three further measured reasons. (1) IT IS THE ONLY STRIKE RULE WITH A MEASURED PRIOR: +1.1342%/trade on secured cash, both halves positive, 84.39% wins, 25.30% assignment, z +7.2506 against a random-day twin, all at 25 delta. (2) THE ALTERNATIVE IS MEASURED TO BE WORSE ON A GATE THIS BOOK MUST PASS: SELL-PREMIUM ran fixed 0.90 moneyness and its K3 fired at 8.900816 years of premium against a 6.0 bar, because that strike collects 0.7778% of strike at a median 44 DTE = 4.4545%/yr against V6-OPT's 2.550% at a median 32 DTE -- the moneyness rule surrenders most of the income, and the income is the crash gate's denominator. (3) A DELTA TARGET IS INVARIANT TO THE VOLATILITY REGIME AND A MONEYNESS TARGET IS NOT, which is a safety property for a forward book facing an unknown regime: at a fixed 0.90 moneyness the premium runs 0.272% of strike at IV 0.25 and 5.359% at IV 0.80, a twenty-fold swing in position size driven by nothing but the regime and scaling UP exactly when vol is highest. V6-OPT was a backtest over a known history and never had to weigh that. THE LIMITATION IS INHERITED AND STATED: this book cannot distinguish a safe dip from a dangerous one. It is a premium-selling book that happens to enter on dips, not a book that selects the safe ones.

structure.arming_amendment: ARMING AMENDMENT, 2026-10-13, BEFORE ANY FILL, AND IT IS F-21's CARRIED ACROSS BECAUSE THIS BOOK'S PRECONDITION IS F-21's AND NOT A WEAKER ONE. This book IS NOW ARMED and the precondition is enforced in CODE: the twin calls the SAME `_f21_source_gate` the arm does - one implementation, so the two can never drift and the twin can never accrue fills the arm had no chance to accrue, which is the coverage mismatch MB1-SEL was VOIDED for. A SECOND REFUSAL IS ADDED AND IT IS THIS BOOK'S ALONE: the entry_rule above names `F22_SALT` and `p` as 'the threshold declared below' and NEITHER IS DECLARED ANYWHERE IN THIS DOCUMENT, so the rule refuses by name with DRAW_PARAMS_UNDECLARED rather than defaulting - a default p of 0 arms a book that can never fire, and any other default would make the code the authority over a frozen parameter (MA5). THE SEQUENCING IS THE DECLARATION'S OWN: p is 're-stated at launch alongside F-21's own fill rate', so this twin cannot be calibrated before the arm has fills and therefore cannot start with it. Declaring p and the salt is a one-line amendment on the day F-21's fill rate is known.

The draw refuses whenever F-21's entry rule refuses - fewer than 20 recorded `dip_healthy` rows, or a latest row more than 5 sessions stale - so the twin can never accrue fills the arm had no chance to accrue. structure.cadence_amendment: EXECUTOR AMENDMENT, 2026-10-13, BEFORE ANY FILL, AND IT IS F-21's A2 CARRIED ACROSS BECAUSE A TWIN THAT RAN ON A DIFFERENT CLOCK WOULD NOT BE THE SAME TRADE. F-21 enters at the cadence of the recorded `dip_healthy` series, which today is weekly rather than daily because the fleet cycle deliberately does not run the dip screen. THIS BOOK'S DRAW IS EVALUATED ON THE SAME SESSIONS F-21's SOURCE WAS RECORDED ON, and on no others. Drawing daily while the arm can only enter weekly would hand the twin five times the entry opportunities and make its fills a biased superset of the arm's - which is the coverage-mismatch defect MB1-SEL was VOIDED for, where the confound ran twice the size of the effect and in the same direction.

structure.v6opt_argument: CARRIED VERBATIM FROM F-21, because a twin that argued differently about its own strike rule would not be the same trade and the comparison would measure the difference in the argument. CONCEDED, NOT DODGED: V6-OPT's autopsy is correct that a delta target sets the strike from the name's own volatility and so equalises assignment by construction -- 25.303% assignment on healthy dips against 25.727% on unhealthy, a 0.43pp gap, where V6-B had measured a real further-20% difference of 2.797pp on those same covered rows. A RISK SIGNAL CANNOT PAY THROUGH A DELTA-TARGETED STRIKE. Neither book carries a risk signal. DECISIONS.md 2026-10-12 judges an options strategy as its own system and its three pass clauses are each unobstructed by a delta target; the only condition it obstructed has been withdrawn by the owner. For THIS book the argument is stronger still: its entry timing reads nothing price-derived at all, so there is no risk signal present even in principle for a strike rule to neutralise. And the alternative is measured to be worse on a gate the pair must pass -- SELL-PREMIUM's K3 fired at 8.900816 years of premium against a 6.0 bar on a fixed 0.90-moneyness rule, which collects 0.7778% of strike at a median 44 DTE = 4.4545%/yr against V6-OPT's 2.550% at a median 32 DTE.
